bio: I build accessible, pixel-perfect things for the web. I care about good design and solid engineering working together.
aboutTitle: Building the future, one line at a time
aboutText: I'm a developer who enjoys building accessible, pixel-precise interfaces that feel good to use and are built right under the hood. Most of the work I like sits right between design and development.

I recently finished my Computer Science degree and I'm looking to join a team where I can build things, learn from others, and keep improving. I lean toward frontend work, but I like getting my hands on the whole stack.
When I'm not coding, I'm usually contributing to open source, reading about new tools and ideas, or building small side projects to keep getting better.
contactBio: I'm currently looking for full-time opportunities. If you're interested in working together or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out!
